items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Lester Patterson out of Beaumont -- he's dead now. Then we had on trombone Willie Tomkins, who took Tommy [LIGHT] Young's place in the Luntzwood band... And, on the reed section, well, I told you, Wild Bill Davis was in that band.

ctx.x: He's not a bad trumpet player.

And we had a guy that loved Roy Eldridge -- I'm trying to think of his name; he's in California right now. Coco Guru, we called him. Eddie Hutchinson. He was in that, and he could play. Lester Patterson out of Beaumont -- he's dead now. Then we had on trombone Willie Tomkins, who took Tommy [LIGHT] Young's place in the Luntzwood band, but didn't stay long on account of he couldn't get -- it was during the war days and he couldn't get living accommodations, because he wanted to bring his wife up, and if he…

And, on the reed section, well, I told you, Wild Bill Davis was in that band. On the bass, we had Lawrence Cato. He's dead today. We had Doe Mills, who is Henry Mills, out of Shreveport, Louisiana on drums, and he's in Detroit today -- he's doing fine.
